mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feed_coeat ( id, user_id, store_id, title, content, capacity, meeting_at, status, auto_accept) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{storeId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{capacity}, #{meetingAt}, #{status}, #{autAccept})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.store_id, c.title, c.content, c.capacity, c.view_count, c.meeting_at, c.status, c.auto_accept, r.created_at, r.updated_at, r.deleted_at, r.blinded_at FROM feed_coeat c JOIN root r ON c.id = r.id WHERE c.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE coeat c JOIN root r ON c.id = r.id SET c.id = #{id}, c.user_id = #{userId}, c.store_id = #{storeId}, c.title = #{title}, c.content = #{content}, c.capacity = #{capacity}, c.view_count = #{viewCount}, c.meeting_at = #{meetingAt}, c.status = #{status}, c.auto_accept = #{autoAccept}, r.updated_at = NOW() WHERE c.id = #{id}
